QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Continental Conference
QuestInfo.0: Claudine is calling for you. Could something be wrong?
QuestInfo.1: Claudine has made an important decision that will affect the fate of the Resistance. She wants to tell you firsthand.
QuestInfo.2: I finally have the opportunity to help those who accepted me and trusted me as a friend. Edelstein will return to its former glory once the Black Mage is defeated.

0.msg: Hello there. I have some Secret Instructions for you. Here, take it.

1.msg: Hello, #b#h0##k. I need to tell you about some changes to the Resistance. A lot is going on right now, so please come to Edelstein ASAP.\r\n

yes.0: Superb. I will be waiting for you.

1.0: Good, you're here. We've received word from the Cygnus Knights that they want to hold what they're calling a Continental Conference. The purpose will be to form an alliance between Explorers, Cygnus Knights, and the Resistance. We would be one force to face the Black Mage.
1.1: The #rBlack Mage#k is a fallen Transcendent that drove Maple World to destruction hundreds of years ago. Five heroes gathered together at the time to stop him, but all they could do was seal him using the Seal Stone of Freud the great magician.
1.2: It's impossible to stand against a being this strong with just the power of one group. That is why, against a threat like the Black Mage, we can't afford to turn down good help.

yes.0: The Cygnus Knights will contact us once everything is ready. I'll see you at the conference. Good hunting to you.
